records.title: Iran warns US energy assets in Gulf are vulnerable after latest clashes
records.claim: Iran warned Gulf energy infrastructure was vulnerable and said a new restricted zone and shipping corridor through Hormuz would be announced; Reuters reported average commodity-ship transits around 10/day over the prior 10 days.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Iran warns US energy assets in Gulf are vulnerable after latest clashes

records.boundary: Threats and announced rules are not the same as executed interdiction; vessel counts are not cargo volumes.

records.title: Oil rises as risks of prolonged Mideast conflict heighten supply worries
records.claim: Brent was $97.34/bbl and WTI $92.63/bbl around 00:00 GMT as markets priced prolonged Gulf supply risk.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Oil rises as risks of prolonged Mideast conflict heighten supply worries

records.boundary: Intraday futures snapshot, not settlement; scenario commentary is analytical opinion, not guaranteed supply loss.

records.title: UAE says its energy exports will not be 'held hostage' by Iran war
records.claim: UAE said it is expanding eastern-coast port capacity and developing pipelines, railways and trade routes to reduce dependence on Hormuz.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: UAE says its energy exports will not be 'held hostage' by Iran war

records.boundary: Capacity, timing and incremental export volumes for each corridor were not quantified in the report.

records.title: TotalEnergies to lower stake in Papua LNG, hand operatorship to Exxon
records.claim: Papua LNG partners restructured ownership/operatorship, reduced estimated capex to about $14bn, and target FID by end-2026 for a 5.6 Mtpa project aimed mainly at Asian buyers.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: TotalEnergies to lower stake in Papua LNG, hand operatorship to Exxon

records.boundary: FID is not yet taken; future LNG supply should not be treated as committed operating capacity.

data_gaps: No accepted new same-window JKM/TTF/China LNG-LPG spot/CP-FEI/VLGC freight series with complete price semantics.
No same-window verified China LNG terminal inventory/utilization series.
No same-window quantified UAE bypass-corridor incremental export capacity.
